findings.title: The public findMany API was removed without a replacement query API
findings.body: This change deletes `findMany`, which previously applied authorization and filter conditions and returned records from `bookingTimeStatusDenormalized`. `getBaseConditions` only returns a SQL fragment; it does not accept or apply the caller's `findMany` arguments, perform the query, or provide an equivalent typed result API. Existing consumers of the exported `InsightsBookingService` that call `findMany` will fail to compile/runtime, and consumers migrated only to this method must reimplement query construction and risk omitting authorization conditions. Preserve `findMany` or introduce an equivalent supported raw-query method and migrate all callers atomically.

findings.title: Team and organization raw authorization predicates are never executed against the database
findings.body: The team and org tests only compare `Prisma.Sql` objects constructed by the service with `Prisma.Sql` objects constructed in the expectation. They do not execute the predicates. The sole `$queryRaw` test at lines 481-484 uses user scope, which has neither the `ANY(${...})` array bindings nor the OR branches used by team/org authorization. Consequently, PostgreSQL serialization/type errors for array parameters, SQL precedence issues, or predicates that return unauthorized/missing bookings in the team and org scopes can pass this suite. Add database-backed tests for both scopes, including matching and non-matching team and member bookings.
